overview:
Layan is the beach area on Phuket's west coast north of Bang Tao, in Choeng Thale, Thalang district; Layan Beach borders a national park. Projects listed here are described as located on or very close to Layan Beach or Layan Bay, including a branded beachfront condominium next to the Anantara Layan resort.
Projects that are only near Layan Beach, such as Layan Green Park, are listed under their primary location (Cherng Talay) and mention Layan as a nearby area.
